automated_decision_no_holds_runs.name: automated_decision_no_holds_runs
automated_decision_no_holds_runs.value: "automated_decisions"."kind" <> 'NO_HOLDS' or ("automated_decisions"."rules_run_id" is not null and "automated_decisions"."model_run_id" is not null and "automated_decisions"."rule_set_version" is not null and "automated_decisions"."model" is not null and "automated_decisions"."prompt_version" is not null)

switch_event_shape.name: switch_event_shape
switch_event_shape.value:
("automation_switch_events"."event" = 'PROPOSE_ON' and "automation_switch_events"."actor_id" is not null and "automation_switch_events"."reason" is null and "automation_switch_events"."proposal_seq" is null and "automation_switch_events"."decision_hash" is null)
    or ("automation_switch_events"."event" = 'ON' and "automation_switch_events"."actor_id" is not null and "automation_switch_events"."reason" is null and "automation_switch_events"."proposal_seq" is not null and "automation_switch_events"."decision_hash" is null)
    or ("automation_switch_events"."event" = 'OFF' and "automation_switch_events"."proposal_seq" is null and (("automation_switch_events"."reason" = 'DISAGREE' and "automation_switch_events"."actor_id" is not null and "automation_switch_events"."decision_hash" is not null)
      or ("automation_switch_events"."reason" = 'UNKNOWN_SEND' and "automation_switch_events"."actor_id" is null and "automation_switch_events"."decision_hash" is not null) or ("automation_switch_events"."reason" = 'APPROVER' and "automation_switch_events"."actor_id" is not null and "automation_switch_events"."decision_hash" is null)))

donation_order_display_name.name: donation_order_display_name
donation_order_display_name.value: "donation_orders"."display_name" is null or (char_length("donation_orders"."display_name") between 1 and 40 and "donation_orders"."display_name" = btrim("donation_orders"."display_name"))

donation_completed_amounts.name: donation_completed_amounts
donation_completed_amounts.value: "donation_receipts"."status" <> 'COMPLETED' or ("donation_receipts"."capture_id" is not null and "donation_receipts"."effective_on" is not null and "donation_receipts"."gross_cents" is not null and "donation_receipts"."fee_cents" is not null and "donation_receipts"."net_cents" is not null and "donation_receipts"."gross_cents" = "donation_receipts"."expected_amount_cents" and "donation_receipts"."fee_cents" >= 0 and "donation_receipts"."net_cents" >= 0 and "donation_receipts"."gross_cents" - "donation_receipts"."fee_cents" = "donation_receipts"."net_cents")

expense_proposal_completion.name: expense_proposal_completion
expense_proposal_completion.value: ("expense_proposals"."state" = 'RUNNING' and "expense_proposals"."completed_at" is null and "expense_proposals"."result" is null) or ("expense_proposals"."state" <> 'RUNNING' and "expense_proposals"."completed_at" is not null)

check_settings_days.name: check_settings_days
check_settings_days.value: "fund_check_settings"."stale_receipt_days" between 1 and 3650 and "fund_check_settings"."duplicate_window_days" between 1 and 3650 and "fund_check_settings"."split_window_days" between 1 and 3650

policy_period_valid.name: policy_period_valid
policy_period_valid.value: ("fund_policy_versions"."period_start" is null and "fund_policy_versions"."period_end" is null) or ("fund_policy_versions"."period_start" is not null and "fund_policy_versions"."period_end" is not null and "fund_policy_versions"."period_start" <= "fund_policy_versions"."period_end")

policy_result_shape.name: policy_result_shape
policy_result_shape.value:
("policy_check_results"."entry" = 'FLAG' and "policy_check_results"."rule_id" in ('P1','P2','P3','P4','P5','P6','P7') and "policy_check_results"."severity" in ('HOLD','NOTE') and "policy_check_results"."flag_text" is not null and "policy_check_results"."reason_code" is null)
    or ("policy_check_results"."entry" = 'NOT_CHECKED' and "policy_check_results"."rule_id" in ('P1','P2','P3','P5','P6') and "policy_check_results"."severity" is null and "policy_check_results"."reason_code" = 'NO_THRESHOLDS' and "policy_check_results"."flag_text" is not null and "policy_check_results"."fund_id" is null and "policy_check_results"."line_id" is null)
    or ("policy_check_results"."entry" = 'RUN_END' and "policy_check_results"."rule_id" is null and "policy_check_results"."severity" is null and "policy_check_results"."reason_code" is null and "policy_check_results"."flag_text" is null and "policy_check_results"."line_id" is null and "policy_check_results"."fund_id" is null)

policy_run_trigger_user.name: policy_run_trigger_user
policy_run_trigger_user.value: ("policy_check_runs"."trigger" = 'APPROVER' and "policy_check_runs"."started_by" is not null) or ("policy_check_runs"."trigger" = 'SWEEP' and "policy_check_runs"."started_by" is null)

policy_run_model_columns.name: policy_run_model_columns
policy_run_model_columns.value: ("policy_check_runs"."kind" = 'RULES' and "policy_check_runs"."model" is null and "policy_check_runs"."effort" is null and "policy_check_runs"."prompt_version" is null and "policy_check_runs"."schema_version" is null and "policy_check_runs"."clause_set_hash" is null and "policy_check_runs"."request_digest" is null) or ("policy_check_runs"."kind" = 'MODEL' and "policy_check_runs"."model" is not null and "policy_check_runs"."effort" is not null and "policy_check_runs"."prompt_version" is not null and "policy_check_runs"."schema_version" is not null and "policy_check_runs"."clause_set_hash" is not null and "policy_check_runs"."request_digest" is not null)

draft_event_bound_version.name: draft_event_bound_version
draft_event_bound_version.value: ("policy_draft_events"."kind" = 'BOUND') = ("policy_draft_events"."bound_policy_version" is not null) and ("policy_draft_events"."bound_policy_version" is null or "policy_draft_events"."bound_policy_version" > 1)

draft_input_bounded.name: draft_input_bounded
draft_input_bounded.value: char_length("policy_drafts"."input_text") between 1 and 20000 and btrim("policy_drafts"."input_text", E' \n\r\t') <> ''

draft_outcome_shape.name: draft_outcome_shape
draft_outcome_shape.value:
("policy_drafts"."outcome" = 'DRAFTED' and "policy_drafts"."draft" is not null and jsonb_typeof("policy_drafts"."draft") = 'object' and "policy_drafts"."refusal_reason" is null and "policy_drafts"."refusal_path" is null)
    or ("policy_drafts"."outcome" = 'REFUSED' and "policy_drafts"."draft" is null and "policy_drafts"."refusal_reason" ~ '^[A-Z_]{1,40}$' and "policy_drafts"."refusal_path" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.]{1,80}$' and "policy_drafts"."parent_draft_id" is null and "policy_drafts"."changed_fields" is null)

draft_edit_shape.name: draft_edit_shape
draft_edit_shape.value:
("policy_drafts"."parent_draft_id" is null and "policy_drafts"."changed_fields" is null
      and "policy_drafts"."model" is not null and "policy_drafts"."effort" is not null and "policy_drafts"."prompt_version" is not null and "policy_drafts"."schema_version" is not null and "policy_drafts"."request_digest" is not null)
    or ("policy_drafts"."parent_draft_id" is not null and "policy_drafts"."outcome" = 'DRAFTED' and "policy_drafts"."changed_fields" is not null and jsonb_typeof("policy_drafts"."changed_fields") = 'array' and jsonb_array_length("policy_drafts"."changed_fields") > 0
      and "policy_drafts"."model" is null and "policy_drafts"."effort" is null and "policy_drafts"."prompt_version" is null and "policy_drafts"."schema_version" is null and "policy_drafts"."request_digest" is null and "policy_drafts"."stop_reason" is null and "policy_drafts"."input_tokens" is null and "policy_drafts"."output_tokens" is null)

draft_counts.name: draft_counts
draft_counts.value: ("policy_drafts"."input_tokens" is null or "policy_drafts"."input_tokens" >= 0) and ("policy_drafts"."output_tokens" is null or "policy_drafts"."output_tokens" >= 0)

model_result_clause_scope.name: model_result_clause_scope
model_result_clause_scope.value: "policy_model_results"."clause_id" is null or "policy_model_results"."fund_id" is not null

model_result_counts.name: model_result_counts
model_result_counts.value: ("policy_model_results"."input_tokens" is null or "policy_model_results"."input_tokens" >= 0) and ("policy_model_results"."output_tokens" is null or "policy_model_results"."output_tokens" >= 0)

model_result_shape.name: model_result_shape
model_result_shape.value:
("policy_model_results"."entry" = 'CALL' and "policy_model_results"."fund_id" is not null and "policy_model_results"."model" is not null and "policy_model_results"."request_digest" is not null and "policy_model_results"."line_id" is null and "policy_model_results"."verdict" is null and "policy_model_results"."clause_id" is null and ("policy_model_results"."reason_code" is null or "policy_model_results"."reason_code" in ('TIMEOUT','UNAVAILABLE','INVALID')))
    or ("policy_model_results"."entry" = 'LINE' and "policy_model_results"."fund_id" is not null and "policy_model_results"."model" is not null and "policy_model_results"."line_id" is not null and "policy_model_results"."verdict" is not null and "policy_model_results"."reason_code" is null and "policy_model_results"."request_digest" is null and "policy_model_results"."stop_reason" is null and "policy_model_results"."input_tokens" is null and "policy_model_results"."output_tokens" is null
      and (("policy_model_results"."verdict" = 'OK' and "policy_model_results"."clause_id" is null) or "policy_model_results"."verdict" = 'UNSURE' or ("policy_model_results"."verdict" = 'CONFLICT' and "policy_model_results"."clause_id" is not null)))
    or ("policy_model_results"."entry" = 'NOT_CHECKED' and "policy_model_results"."fund_id" is not null and "policy_model_results"."reason_code" in ('TIMEOUT','UNAVAILABLE','INVALID','LIMIT','NO_CLAUSES') and "policy_model_results"."line_id" is null and "policy_model_results"."verdict" is null and "policy_model_results"."clause_id" is null and "policy_model_results"."request_digest" is null and "policy_model_results"."stop_reason" is null and "policy_model_results"."input_tokens" is null and "policy_model_results"."output_tokens" is null and (("policy_model_results"."reason_code" = 'NO_CLAUSES') = ("policy_model_results"."model" is null)))
    or ("policy_model_results"."entry" = 'SKIPPED' and "policy_model_results"."fund_id" is not null and "policy_model_results"."reason_code" = 'GENERAL_FUND' and "policy_model_results"."model" is null and "policy_model_results"."line_id" is null and "policy_model_results"."verdict" is null and "policy_model_results"."clause_id" is null and "policy_model_results"."request_digest" is null and "policy_model_results"."stop_reason" is null and "policy_model_results"."input_tokens" is null and "policy_model_results"."output_tokens" is null)
    or ("policy_model_results"."entry" = 'RUN_END' and "policy_model_results"."fund_id" is null and "policy_model_results"."model" is null and "policy_model_results"."line_id" is null and "policy_model_results"."verdict" is null and "policy_model_results"."clause_id" is null and "policy_model_results"."reason_code" is null and "policy_model_results"."request_digest" is null and "policy_model_results"."stop_reason" is null and "policy_model_results"."input_tokens" is null and "policy_model_results"."output_tokens" is null)

receipt_prohibited_screen_shape.name: receipt_prohibited_screen_shape
receipt_prohibited_screen_shape.value: "receipt_confirmations"."prohibited_screen" is null or (case when jsonb_typeof("receipt_confirmations"."prohibited_screen") = 'object' and jsonb_typeof("receipt_confirmations"."prohibited_screen"->'version') = 'string' and jsonb_typeof("receipt_confirmations"."prohibited_screen"->'matches') = 'array' and jsonb_typeof("receipt_confirmations"."prohibited_screen"->'unresolved') = 'array' and jsonb_typeof("receipt_confirmations"."prohibited_screen"->'acknowledged') = 'boolean' then ("receipt_confirmations"."prohibited_screen"->'acknowledged' = 'true'::jsonb) = (jsonb_array_length("receipt_confirmations"."prohibited_screen"->'unresolved') > 0) else false end)

photo_read_prefill.name: photo_read_prefill
photo_read_prefill.value: ("receipt_photo_reads"."outcome" = 'READ') = ("receipt_photo_reads"."prefill_sha256" is not null) and ("receipt_photo_reads"."prefill_sha256" is null or "receipt_photo_reads"."prefill_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')

receipt_ready_evidence.name: receipt_ready_evidence
receipt_ready_evidence.value: "receipt_suggestions"."status" <> 'READY' or ("receipt_suggestions"."proposals" is not null and "receipt_suggestions"."audit" is not null)

receipt_suggestion_provider.name: receipt_suggestion_provider
receipt_suggestion_provider.value: ("receipt_suggestions"."status" = 'READY') = ("receipt_suggestions"."provider" is not null) and ("receipt_suggestions"."provider" is null) = ("receipt_suggestions"."model" is null) and ("receipt_suggestions"."provider" is null or "receipt_suggestions"."provider" in ('local','claude')) and ("receipt_suggestions"."provider" is distinct from 'local' or (not ("receipt_suggestions"."audit" ? 'provider') and "receipt_suggestions"."model" = "receipt_suggestions"."audit"->>'modelRevision' and "receipt_suggestions"."model" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{40}$') is true) and ("receipt_suggestions"."provider" is distinct from 'claude' or ("receipt_suggestions"."audit"->>'provider' = 'claude' and "receipt_suggestions"."model" = "receipt_suggestions"."audit"->>'model' and "receipt_suggestions"."model" in ('claude-haiku-5-5','claude-sonnet-5-5')) is true)
